name: Seeded banana
summary: Seeded banana from the hills, sold on the path up to Ao Tiên and from the gate down to the lake, as a gift and a remedy.
origin: The paths around the lake. VnExpress, 2 December 2014. The headline says chuối rừng. The body says chuối hột.
howToEat: Buy a hand. VnExpress says the fruit is also used as a remedy. Do not treat that line as a prescription.
VnExpress printed about 20,000–25,000 VND a hand on 2 December 2014.
where: The path up to Ao Tien, and the stretch from the gate down to the lake.
priceBand: VnExpress printed about 20,000–25,000 VND a hand on 2 December 2014. A current price is Check on arrival.
